2. Scope of Work Executed
Small Buildings works for Trishakti Power Generation Corporation completed 2022.
The work was carried out under site conditions that included hard rock encountered below the founding
level over part of the alignment. The agency organised its resources around this without recourse to the
department for additional assistance, and the programme was re-sequenced locally to keep the critical path
intact.
An extension of time was granted during execution on account of delayed handover of the site frontage by
the local authority. The delay was examined by this office and held to be beyond the agency's control; no
compensation was claimed and none has been paid.
The above work was executed under the supervision of the undersigned in accordance with the approved
drawings, specifications, and the terms and conditions of the contract. The work has been completed in all
respects and has been got inspected by the Engineer-in-Chief / Superintending Engineer.
DOC-CC-148

3. Quality Assessment
The overall quality of the completed work is graded Very Good. Workmanship was consistently within
tolerance, and a joint inspection was held before final measurement. Materials were drawn from approved
sources and the test results filed with this office were within the limits prescribed in the contract
specification.

5. Deficiency / Observation List
At the time of taking over, kerb alignment corrected over a 40 m stretch after joint inspection. Regarding site
safety, one first-aid case was recorded and closed with a toolbox briefing. The agency's conduct during the
contract is recorded as responsive throughout the defect liability period.
Nil. No major deficiencies observed during the final inspection carried out on 2022-04-16. All minor
observations pointed out during the interim inspections have been rectified to the satisfaction of the
inspecting authority.
6. Recommendation
Having satisfied myself as to the quantity and quality of the work executed, and on the basis of the joint
measurements recorded in the measurement book, I certify the work complete and recommend release of the
balance payment together with the retention money due on expiry of the defect liability period. Certified by
T. Sinha, Deputy General Manager (Projects).
On joint measurement and final inspection, the executed quantities were found in order and the
workmanship conforming to the technical specifications forming part of the contract.
